snippet.title: CyberKitty: Neon Merge Official Trailer
snippet.description:
🐾Discover CyberKitty: Neon Merge, a colorful Suika-inspired game coming to PC, Mac & Steam Deck on November 19.

Merge and discover new CyberKitties as you progress through a bright futuristic world packed with neon visuals, satisfying progression, and adorable cyber-powered cats.

If you enjoy merge games, casual puzzle games, cozy games, cat games, indie games, satisfying progression, and cyberpunk-inspired visuals, CyberKitty: Neon Merge is made for you!

We’re also excited to be participating in the October edition of Steam Next Fest — add CyberKitty: Neon Merge to your wishlist and follow the game on Steam so you don’t miss upcoming updates and event news!

🎮 *Wishlist CyberKitty: Neon Merge on Steam:*
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5061450/CyberKitty_Neon_Merge/

*Coming to:*
Steam (PC & Mac)
